 ● The percentage of older adults who had a dental visit decreased from 65.4% among those 
ages 65–74 and 63.6% among those ages 75–84 to 53.3% among those age 85 and older.

response_text: In 2022, about 64% of U.S. adults age 65 and older saw a dentist in the past year, with women slightly more likely to go than men (64.9% vs. 62.3%). Dental visits became less common with age, dropping from 65.4% among those ages 65–74 to 53.3% among those age 85 and older.
